name: What makes professional urine cleanup better than DIY methods?

mainEntity.name: What makes professional urine cleanup better than DIY methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional urine cleanup is typically more effective than DIY methods because professionals have access to industrial-grade equipment and specialized cleaning agents. These tools can detect hidden urine, extract deeply absorbed contaminants, and neutralize odor-causing bacteria that common household cleaners cannot reach or eliminate. Professionals also understand material science and proper drying techniques to prevent secondary damage like mold growth, ensuring a more thorough and lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use industrial-grade equipment and specialized cleaners to detect hidden urine, extract deeply absorbed contaminants, and neutralize odors more effectively than DIY methods.
